target_customer: Companies and teams that want a workplace messenger where AI agents act as teammates; Enterprise tier sold by demo or sales
problem: Existing team chat treats AI as an add on, so teams cannot easily create agents that work in shared conversations with their own tools and logins.
business_model: Freemium team messenger with an Enterprise tier sold through sales

founders.name: Mith Paresh Patel
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no employers or education.

founders.name: Carl Huang
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no employers or education; CTO role is the only technical signal.

competitors.name: Slack with Slackbot
competitors.what: Slack relaunched Slackbot as a personal AI agent in early 2026 and hosts third party agents

competitors.name: Bloome
competitors.what: Agent-first group chat where agents are mentioned

technical_complexity.rationale: A real time messenger plus agent runtime with computer and login access is standard engineering with hard parts in agent sandboxing and reliability for a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: A messenger gains lock-in only after teams migrate, and Slack and others added agents; no traction evidence found.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Slack relaunched Slackbot as an agent in early 2026 and added agent integrations, putting the wedge directly in an incumbent roadmap.

market_need_then: Teams adopted AI agents quickly in 2025 and 2026 and incumbents responded with agent features, which shows demand; no customer or usage evidence for Sila itself was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses silahq.com (HQ suffix); company entity Sila Intelligence Inc.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, direct, benefit focused short lines such as Your entire company. Now AI-Native.

brand_strength.rationale: Short but shared with a fintech and a battery company also named Sila, which causes confusion in search results; no press on the brand.

outcome_analysis: Sila is a two person Winter 2026 team messenger with no public exit and no confirmed funding. It faces Slack's own agent push and name confusion with other companies called Sila, and no traction evidence was found, so the outcome is open.
notes: Funding aggregators disagree and no company or press source confirms any round, so no round is recorded. The Sila website lists investors including SpaceX, Scale AI, DoorDash, Stripe and Reddit as backers, but no source gave rounds or amounts, so none is recorded. Caplight and other funding results belong to different companies named Sila. Founder prior employers and education not found. Later entrants such as Ando (Sept 2026) are excluded as after founding.
